snapshots.reason: First major module addition (GLA module) after initial RetNet implementation. Core architecture established with both RetNet and GLA, representing the foundational stage with essential attention mechanisms.

analysis_summary: Repository spans 2 years (Dec 2023 - Dec 2025) with 1759 commits. Evolution shows clear progression: foundational stage (43 files) with core RetNet/GLA implementations, major expansion at v0.1.0 (288 files) establishing package structure and multiple variants, and mature state (468 files) with extensive optimizations and diverse attention mechanisms. Version tags (v0.1.0-v0.4.0) provide clear milestones. File growth pattern (43→288→468) indicates steady complexity increase suitable for curriculum learning.
